items.title: File Einspruch against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Frist: zwei Wochen nach dem Tag der Zustellung.
items.computation: The envelope's Zustellungsurkunde (page 2) records actual delivery on 19.09.2025 (Friday) via förmliche Zustellung. Per §187 Abs.1 BGB / §43 Abs.1 StPO the day of delivery itself is not counted; the two-week period starts 20.09.2025 and would end two weeks later on Friday 03.10.2025. That date is Tag der Deutschen Einheit, a nationwide public holiday, so under §43 Abs.2 StPO / §31 Abs.3 VwVfG the deadline shifts to the next working day, Monday 06.10.2025.

items.title: Pay the total fine amount (Gesamtbetrag)
items.quote: Zahlung: Gesamtbetrag binnen zwei Wochen ab Rechtskraft auf das unten angegebene Konto
items.computation: Payment is due two weeks after the decision becomes final (Rechtskraft), which only occurs once the Einspruch period expires without an appeal being filed. Assuming no Einspruch is lodged, the Einspruch deadline (computed above) expires 06.10.2025, so Rechtskraft is reached at the end of that day. Counting the two-week payment period from the day after (§187 Abs.1 BGB), it runs from 07.10.2025 to Monday 20.10.2025 (no weekend/holiday adjustment needed, as 20.10.2025 is a normal Monday). This date is provisional: if an Einspruch is filed, Rechtskraft does not occur and this payment deadline does not apply.

warnings: The payment due date (20.10.2025) assumes no Einspruch is filed by the 06.10.2025 deadline; if an Einspruch is lodged, the fine is not yet final (keine Rechtskraft) and this payment deadline does not apply — check with the Bußgeldstelle.

The IBAN given for payment (DE34 5205 0000 0000 0034 34) is a valid German IBAN with a plausible bank code, but as always verify it matches official Zentrale Bußgeldstelle Musterland details before paying, since bank details from a single letter should not be trusted blindly.
